episodes.title: Wrath
episodes.summary: Father-to-be Ethan leaves his wife behind and takes orphan Louis to hunt for food in the mountains, where a pack of ferocious wolves set upon them.

episodes.title: Gluttony
episodes.summary: Cassardis lies in ruins. When a magical Pawn revives Ethan, he vows revenge, embarking on a quest to slay the dragon that destroyed his world.

episodes.title: Envy
episodes.summary: Ethan and Hannah aid a traveling party being ambushed by goblins. The groups make camp together, but a predatory griffin swoops in from above.

episodes.title: Sloth
episodes.summary: The pair make their way through a cavern that once housed a bustling narcotics operation. Deeper inside, a towering hydra stalks the depths.

episodes.title: Greed
episodes.summary: Ethan and Hannah reunite with royal guards Simon and Balthazar, agreeing to help them destroy a greedy lich who commands an army of undead.

episodes.title: Lust
episodes.summary: Hannah convinces Ethan to rest at an inn before marching on to the dragon's lair. In his room, a vision of his wife brings back Ethan's past.

episodes.title: Pride
episodes.summary: Ethan makes his way to the Tainted Mountain to face the dragon and reclaim his stolen heart, or die trying.
